hits.description:
Not affiliated with Roblox. Research project, use at your own risk. Read the notice on our website before using.
      We ported Roblox to Linux because they wouldn't.
      
        Enjoy millions of experiences on Roblox, chat with friends, and explore!
        Seamlessly run Roblox on Linux, faster than on Windows.
        No emulators. No virtual machines. No cruft. We disable ads and telemetry by default.
        No strings attached - Sober is a community project. We made it closed source to reduce the potential for abuse (which would lead to Roblox blocking us again)
      
      Make Sober your own. See our documentation for a list of options.
      
        Turn on server location indicators, bring back the nostalgic oof sound, customize textures, try experimental settings, and more.

hits.description:
Heroic es un lanzador de juegos de código abierto. Actualmente admite iniciar juegos de la
      Epic Games Store con Legendary, juegos de GOG con nuestra implementación personalizada gogdl
      y juegos de Amazon con Nile.
      Funciones principales:
      
        Accede a tus juegos de Epic, GOG y Amazon en una interfaz de usuario intuitiva.
        Agrega juegos fuera de GOG, Amazon o Epic Games Store, nativos o no. Incluso se admiten aplicaciones de navegador.
        Una cola de descarga para descargar varios juegos a la vez.
        Instala y lanza tus juegos de Windows usando Wine o Proton. O lanza tus juegos nativos de GOG.
        Soporte de guardado en la nube para GOG y Epic Games.
        Importa juegos instalados desde Epic Store o GOG Galaxy.
        Verifica y repara instalaciones corruptas o incluso mueve tu instalación a diferentes carpetas.
        Administrador Proton/Wine integrado para una instalación sencilla de nuevas y actualizaciones.
        Winetricks integrado
        Soporte para instalación y desinstalación de DLCs de juegos
        Accede a la tienda de Epic y GOG, así como a la Wiki de Heroic directamente desde la aplicación.
        Consulta la puntuación en Metacritic, IGCB u OpenCritic para el juego.
        Y muchas más funciones
      
      Limitaciones actuales en Flatpak:
      
        Debido a problemas con el controlador en el modo de juego SteamDeck, Heroic utiliza Flatpak Runtime 23.08 en la rama estable. Si necesitas runtime 24.08 para tener soporte HDR y más, utiliza la rama beta de Flathub.
hits.name: Heroic
hits.summary: Juega juegos de Epic, GOG y Amazon

hits.description:
Prism Launcher is a custom launcher for Minecraft that focuses on predictability, long term stability and simplicity.
      Features:
      
        Easily install game modifications, such as Fabric, Forge and Quilt
        Easily install and update modpacks from the Launcher
        Control your Java settings, and enable Mangohud or Gamemode with a toggle
        Manage worlds and resource packs from the launcher
        See logs and other details easily through a dashboard
        Kill Minecraft in case of a crash/freeze
        Isolate Minecraft instances to keep everything clean
        Install and update mods directly from the launcher
        Customize the launcher with themes, and more
        And cat :3
hits.name: Prism Launcher
hits.summary: Custom Minecraft Launcher to easily manage multiple Minecraft installations at once

hits.description:
Install and manage Wine- and Proton-based compatibility tools for Steam and Lutris with this graphical user interface.
    
      Supported launchers:
      
        Steam
        Lutris
        Heroic Games Launcher
        Bottles
        WineZGUI
        Both normal, Snap and Flatpak installations are supported
      
      Supported compatibility tools:
      
        GE-Proton
        SteamTinkerLaunch
        Proton-Tkg
        Luxtorpeda
        Boxtron
        Roberta
        NorthstarProton
        Scrumplex's Steam-Play-None
        Wine-GE
        Lutris-Wine
        Kron4ek's Vanilla Wine-Builds
        DXVK and DXVK async (includes D8VK)
        VKD3D
      
      Double click compatibility tools to show more information and games using the tool.
      Advanced settings and the color theme can be managed in the About dialog.
hits.name: ProtonUp-Qt
hits.summary: Install Wine- and Proton-based compatibility tools

hits.description: Dolphin is an emulator for two recent Nintendo video game consoles: the GameCube and the Wii. It allows PC gamers to enjoy games for these two consoles in full HD (1080p) with several enhancements: compatibility with all PC controllers, turbo speed, networked multiplayer, and even more!
hits.name: Dolphin Emulator
